messages:
Maya: Quick check — where are we on console observability milestones? Specifically: dashboard M2 retention, tracing hook rollout for routing-service, and the error-analysis views. Need owners and any blockers.
Sam: PM update — roadmap shows M2 target end of next sprint (Thu 4/18). We need owners to confirm. I'm happy to own rollout coordination.
Lucas: I can take dashboard retention work but blocked by storage schema PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1423 — needs schema migration plan and perf tests.
Anya: FYI on retention: cost delta estimate after schema change is +12% for cold reads unless we add a TTL compaction job. Do we want shorter retention for low-priority traces?
Maya: @lucas can you paste the migration PR summary? @anya what's the TTL compaction cost estimate in $/month?
Lucas: PR summary: small column add, backfill of 3 months of traces, and a rolling reindex. Perf tests show 30% write amplification during backfill window. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1423
Anya: TTL compaction estimate ~ $1.5k/mo for the prod cluster at current ingest, or ~ $800/mo if we cap retention to 30 days for non-error traces.
Tiago: tracing hooks: two services missing instrumentation — routing-service and legacy-ingest. I can add the hook to legacy-ingest this week, routing-service needs a contract change (context header). Sample snippet for routing-service: 
```python
# add trace header to outbound calls
headers = {**req.headers, 'x-rd-trace': span.context.to_header()}
client.request(..., headers=headers)
```
Maya: Who wants routing-service contract change? This touches product APIs. @sam any concerns with adding x-rd-trace header?
Sam: fine with header, small privacy note — we should document in API changelog and feature flag it. I'll create the feature flag ticket.
Lucas: I'll pick up the migration plan writeup today and ping for PR review when ready.
infra-bot: deploy: staging canary succeeded for platform/obs-migration (canary id c-2024-11-03) :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: alert: trace-ingest queue lag spike yesterday 22:13 — mitigated, SLO unaffected.
Maya: OK next steps: @lucas migration doc + timeline by EOD, @tiago add legacy-ingest hook this sprint, @sam create feature flag + changelog. I'll update the roadmap board and mark dependencies. If there are blockers drop here or DM me. :thumbsup:
